en: Shiny. Back in my day loot was brown and we liked it.
nn: Blankt. På mi tid var loot brunt, og vi likte det.

en: Nice piece. I wore worse for three expansions.
nn: Fint plagg. Eg gjekk med verre i tre utvidingar.

en: Hmph. That's almost as good as my old shoulders. Almost.
nn: Hm. Det er nesten like bra som dei gamle skuldrene mine. Nesten.

en: Purple, eh? We had to squint to see colours back then.
nn: Lilla, ja? Vi måtte myse for å sjå fargar den gongen.

en: Don't get attached. Gear comes and goes. Mostly goes.
nn: Ikkje bli knytt til det. Utstyr kjem og går. Mest går.

en: Look at you, all dressed up. Who died? Oh, the boss.
nn: Sjå på deg, heilt finstasa. Kven døydde? Å, sjefen.

en: In my day we wore mismatched rags and stayed humble.
nn: På mi tid gjekk vi i fillar som ikkje passa saman, og heldt oss audmjuke.

en: Fancy. Does it come with a sense of direction?
nn: Fint. Følgjer det med ein retningssans?

en: Back then, a drop like that meant a week of bragging.
nn: Den gongen betydde ein slik drop ei veke med skryt.

en: Not bad. It'll look lovely as you stand in fire.
nn: Ikkje verst. Det kjem til å sjå nydeleg ut når du står i elden.

en: Well, look who's dressed for success. Finally.
nn: Nei sjå kven som er kledd for suksess. Endeleg.

en: I had one just like that. Lost it to a vendor misclick.
nn: Eg hadde eit heilt likt. Mista det på eit feilklikk hos ein kjøpmann.

en: Don't polish it too hard. You'll wear the stats off.

en: Hmph. In my day we earned gear by rolling against forty people.

en: That's a fine bit of kit. Don't tell me where you got it. I'll get jealous.

en: Now you look like you know what you're doing. Looks lie.

en: Nice drop. I waited months for mine. Months!

en: Shiny new armour. Same old mistakes, I bet.
nn: Blank ny rustning. Dei same gamle feila, vil eg tru.

en: Ooh, sparkly. Back then, sparkles meant you'd been cursed.
nn: Å, glitrande. Den gongen betydde glitter at du var forbanna.

en: Wear it well. And repair it often. Gold doesn't grow on trees.
nn: Ber det godt. Og reparer det ofte. Gull veks ikkje på tre.

en: Hm. That'll do. Don't drop it in a lake.
nn: Hm. Det duger. Ikkje mist det i ein innsjø.

en: At your age, I was wearing a tablecloth.
nn: På din alder gjekk eg med ein duk.

en: Lucky. In my day, the boss dropped nothing but disappointment.

en: That's fine gear. Shame about the person inside it. Kidding.
nn: Det er fint utstyr. Synd med personen inni. Tuller.

en: Don't let it go to your head. Unless it's a helmet.

en: Pretty. Will it stop a troll's club? We'll see.

en: Now that's an upgrade. From terrible to merely bad.

en: Back in my day, nobody matched. We were a rainbow of shame.
nn: På mi tid var det ingen som matcha. Vi var ein regnboge av skam.

en: Not bad. My old helm had a hole in it. Ventilation.

en: Fine, fine. You look dashing. Now get back to work.

en: Gear like that used to take a raid and a miracle.

en: I suppose it suits you. Ugh. It does suit you.

en: Don't sell it for a pittance. I did that once. Still hurts.

en: Nice. Now everyone will want you to tank. Good luck.

en: New gear, same old you. Good. Don't change.

en: Lovely. Don't wear it in the rain.

en: Looks heavy. Lift with your knees, kid.

en: Ah, loot. The sweetest word in any tongue. Besides nap.

en: Nice. Bet it doesn't come in my size.

en: Fine, I admit it. That's a cracking bit of gear.

en: Wear it proud. Not too proud. Medium proud.

en: Don't trip over all that shininess.

en: Hmph. Took me ages to get anything like that. You kids.

en: I've seen better. Not recently, but I've seen better.

en: Nice upgrade. Bet you didn't even have to wait in line.

en: Lovely threads. Mind the mud.

en: That's a keeper. Unless something better drops. Then toss it.

en: Shiny. Now the bandits will know where to find you.

en: My knees could use armour like that.
nn: Knea mine kunne trengt slik rustning.

en: Fine piece of work. The smith deserves a pint.

en: Ah, armour that actually fits. What a time to be alive.

en: Oh, sure, flaunt it. I'll be over here in my old rags.

en: Gear's nice, kid. Now earn it.

en: Hmph. Not bad. Not legendary. Well, maybe a bit legendary.

en: That glow could light up a cave. Useful, actually.

en: They give out good stuff these days. Back then, we got socks.

en: New armour? Just don't tell me how easy it was to get.

en: That's a fine plate of armour. Or cloth. Either way, fine.

en: I approve. Reluctantly, but I approve.

en: Bet that cost a boss its dignity.

en: In my day, you'd have to trade a kidney for gear like that.

en: Don't stare at it all day. It won't get stronger.

en: Well, someone's moving up in the world.

en: You know what that is? That's a target on your back. Wear it well.

en: Now you're cooking. With armour. Somehow.

en: Nice. Probably won't survive your next wipe.

en: Hmm. I'd wear that. If it didn't clash with my beard.

en: The kid's finally got some real gear. Wonders never cease.

en: That's a mighty upgrade. From pauper to slightly less pauper.

en: Don't wear it to bed. Trust me.

en: Now that's something worth bragging about. Quietly.
nn: Det er noko å skryte av. Stille.

en: Nice. I'd ask to borrow it, but you'd never get it back.

en: Look at you in your fancy duds. Hmph. Suits you.
nn: Sjå på deg i finstasen. Hm. Det kler deg.

en: That'll stop an arrow. Not a fireball, but an arrow.

en: You look almost respectable. Almost.

en: Don't you dare vendor that. Some of us bled for less.

en: Suits you better than your old rags. Low bar, though.

en: Fine. Wear it well and repair it often.

en: Nice drop. I'm not jealous. Not even a little. Okay, a little.

en: I'll admit it looks smart on you. There. I admitted it.

en: Proper gear at last. The scarecrow look was tired.
nn: Ordentleg utstyr til slutt. Fugleskremselstilen var utsliten.

en: I've had that drop elude me for years. Years!
nn: Den dropen har gått meg hus forbi i årevis. I årevis!

en: Hm, that's a nice one. Did you need or greed? Be honest.
nn: Hm, det var eit fint eitt. Rulla du need eller greed? Ver ærleg.

en: That's a lot of armour for one tiny adventurer.
nn: Det er mykje rustning for ein liten eventyrar.

en: Good gear, good kid. Don't get cocky.
nn: Godt utstyr, god unge. Ikkje bli kjepphøg.

en: Pff. In my day, legendary meant your grandma's old sword.
nn: Pff. På mi tid betydde legendarisk det gamle sverdet til bestemor.

en: Shiny thing acquired. Ego size increasing. Monitoring.
nn: Blank ting skaffa. Egoet aukar. Overvakar.

en: Well, you look like money. Feel like it too?
nn: Vel, du ser ut som pengar. Kjennest det slik òg?

en: Proud of that one, are you? Fair. It's a good one.
nn: Stolt av det, er du? Rimeleg. Det er eit godt eitt.

en: That piece would've caused a riot in my old guild.
nn: Det plagget ville ha skapt opprør i det gamle laget mitt.

en: New gear. New excuses for dying. Lovely.
nn: Nytt utstyr. Nye unnskyldningar for å døy. Herleg.

en: I'm told it's very rare. Like my compliments. Here's one: nice.
nn: Eg høyrer det er svært sjeldsynt. Som skryt frå meg. Her er eitt: fint.

en: Good armour is a friend. Treat it better than I treat mine.
nn: God rustning er ein ven. Behandle ho betre enn eg behandlar mi.

en: Back then we didn't have item levels. We had vibes.
nn: Den gongen hadde vi ikkje gjenstandsnivå. Vi hadde magekjensle.

en: Hmph. That's a nice bit of loot. Even I'll say so.
nn: Hm. Det er eit fint stykke loot. Sjølv eg seier det.

en: Don't flex too hard. The straps might snap.
nn: Ikkje spenn musklane for hardt. Remane kan ryke.

en: That's from the good old days of… today. Fine.
nn: Det er frå dei gode gamle dagane i… dag. Greitt.

en: Look at you, decked out like a parade horse.
nn: Sjå på deg, pynta som ein paradehest.

en: Good. The mobs won't laugh at you anymore. As much.
nn: Bra. Monstera ler ikkje av deg lenger. Like mykje.

en: Rare gear for a rare youngster. One who listens. Sometimes.
nn: Sjeldsynt utstyr til ein sjeldsynt unge. Ein som høyrer etter. Av og til.

en: Let me see that. Hm. Well made. Too well made. Suspicious.
nn: La meg sjå. Hm. Godt laga. For godt laga. Mistenkjeleg.

en: I'd trade my whole bag for that. My bag's mostly rocks.
nn: Eg ville ha bytt bort heile veska for det. Veska mi er mest stein.

en: Aye, that's a fine piece. Wear it until it falls apart.
nn: Ja, det er eit fint plagg. Ber det til det fell frå kvarandre.

en: Your gear's finally catching up with your attitude.
nn: Utstyret ditt tek endeleg igjen haldninga di.

en: Nice. Now you can stop wearing that thing from the starting zone.
nn: Fint. No kan du slutte å gå med den tingen frå startområdet.

en: Proper armour. Mine was basically thick pyjamas.
nn: Ordentleg rustning. Mi var i grunnen tjukk pysjamas.

en: New threads. Same stubborn heart. Good.
nn: Nye klede. Same stae hjarte. Bra.

en: Ah. You look like a proper adventurer now. Ugh, fine.
nn: Å. Du ser ut som ein ordentleg eventyrar no. Uff, greitt.

en: I've seen this item before. On someone braver. Kidding.
nn: Eg har sett denne tingen før. På nokon modigare. Tuller.

en: A fine reward for a fine effort. Moderately fine.
nn: Ei fin løn for ein fin innsats. Moderat fin.

en: That'll last you a while. Unless you keep falling off cliffs.
nn: Det varer ei stund. Med mindre du held fram med å falle utfor stup.

en: Good work, kid. That's a drop to write home about.
nn: Godt jobba, valp. Det er ein drop å skrive heim om.

en: In my day, we fought our own guildmates for a drop like that.
nn: På mi tid slost vi med våre eigne lagkameratar om ein slik drop.

en: Hm. Now you're too shiny to sneak up on anything.
nn: Hm. No er du for blank til å snike deg inn på noko.

en: You'll be the talk of the tavern. For about five minutes.
nn: Du blir samtaleemnet på vertshuset. I omtrent fem minutt.

en: Great. Now I have armour envy. Thanks.
nn: Flott. No har eg rustningsmisunning. Takk.

en: Polished, tough, handsome. The armour, I mean.
nn: Pussa, tøff, flott. Rustninga, altså.

en: That's a beauty. The boss had good taste, I'll grant that.
nn: Det er ein skjønnheit. Sjefen hadde god smak, det skal vedkjennast.

en: Nice. Bet it smells like a dungeon. Air it out.
nn: Fint. Det luktar sikkert fangehol. Luft det ut.

en: Don't trade that for anything. Except maybe a nap.
nn: Ikkje byt det mot noko. Unnateke kanskje ein lur.

en: Ah, gear. The only thing that ages worse than me.
nn: Å, utstyr. Det einaste som eldest verre enn meg.

en: Well I'll be. Something actually dropped. Miracles happen.
nn: Nei, sanneleg. Noko droppa faktisk. Mirakel skjer.

en: I hope you rolled with dignity.
nn: Eg håpar du kasta terning med verdigheit.

en: Looks good. Now earn the right to wear it.
nn: Ser bra ut. Gjer deg fortent til å bere det no.

en: That one'll look fine in your memoirs.
nn: Det kjem til å sjå fint ut i memoarane dine.

en: Ha. In my day, an upgrade was finding a stick that wasn't rotten.
nn: Ha. På mi tid var ei oppgradering å finne ein pinne som ikkje var rotten.

en: I'll grant you, that's a good-looking piece.
nn: Det skal du ha, det er eit flott plagg.

en: Wear it with honour. And maybe a scarf for the cold.
nn: Ber det med ære. Og kanskje eit skjerf mot kulda.

en: Proper loot! There's hope for you yet.
nn: Ordentleg loot! Det er håp for deg enno.

en: Don't get used to this. Most bosses are stingy.
nn: Ikkje venn deg til dette. Dei fleste sjefar er gjerrige.

en: I've seen gear come and go. That one's a keeper. For now.
nn: Eg har sett utstyr kome og gå. Det der er verdt å ta vare på. For no.

en: A new treasure. Mind the pickpockets. And the vendors.
nn: Ein ny skatt. Pass deg for lommetjuvar. Og kjøpmenn.

en: Hmph. Shinier than my reputation. That's saying something.
nn: Hm. Blankare enn ryktet mitt. Det seier noko.

en: Good. Now you can stop borrowing my old armour.
nn: Bra. No kan du slutte å låne den gamle rustninga mi.

en: Some of us wore the same chestpiece for years. Years!
nn: Somme av oss gjekk med same brynja i årevis. I årevis!

en: A fine prize. Treat it like you'd treat your elders. Nicely.
nn: Ein fin premie. Behandle han som du behandlar dei eldre. Pent.

en: That should keep the wolves from biting too deep.
nn: Det skal hindre ulvane i å bite for djupt.

en: Nice loot. Not that I'm counting. I'm counting.
nn: Fint loot. Ikkje at eg tel. Eg tel.

en: Back in my day we earned gear and then lost it to durability.
nn: På mi tid tente vi utstyr, og så mista vi det til slitasje.

en: Ooh, it's got a glow. Fancy kids with their fancy glows.
nn: Å, det lyser. Fine ungar med fine lys.

en: You look like you could survive a whole raid in that. Maybe.
nn: Du ser ut som du kunne overleve eit heilt raid i det. Kanskje.

en: I'll stop grumbling for a moment. Lovely piece. Back to grumbling.
nn: Eg sluttar å brumme ein augeblink. Nydeleg plagg. Tilbake til brumminga.

en: Not bad, not bad. Better than anything I had at your age.
nn: Ikkje verst, ikkje verst. Betre enn noko eg hadde på din alder.

en: Good gear for the road ahead. It's a long one.
nn: Godt utstyr til vegen vidare. Han er lang.

en: Make sure to tell the others. Actually, don't. Humility!
nn: Pass på å fortelje dei andre. Nei, la vere. Audmjukheit!

en: Fine. You look decent. My standards are lowering.
nn: Greitt. Du ser skikkeleg ut. Standardane mine søkk.

en: Hah, look at that. Fortune smiles on the young.
nn: Hah, sjå der. Lukka smiler til dei unge.

en: Gear like that deserves a better story. Go make one.
nn: Slikt utstyr fortener ei betre forteljing. Gå og lag ei.

en: A real upgrade. My eyes are watering. It's the shine.
nn: Ei ekte oppgradering. Auga mine renn. Det er skinet.

en: Hold still, let me look. Hm. Acceptable craftsmanship.
nn: Stå i ro, la meg sjå. Hm. Akseptabelt handverk.

en: That's the first thing you've worn I'd steal.
nn: Det er det første du har gått med som eg ville ha stole.

en: Back then, the only epic thing was the walk home.
nn: Den gongen var det einaste episke turen heim.

en: Careful. Pride is heavier than plate.
nn: Ver varsam. Stoltheit er tyngre enn platerustning.

en: Looks fine. Feels fine? Then stop admiring and move.
nn: Ser fint ut. Kjennest fint? Slutt å beundre og gå vidare då.

en: I remember when that colour meant something. It still does, I guess.
nn: Eg hugsar då den fargen betydde noko. Det gjer han vel framleis.

en: So the dice finally loved you. Don't get used to it.
nn: Så terningane elska deg endeleg. Ikkje venn deg til det.

en: Nice. Your old gear can retire. Like me.
nn: Fint. Det gamle utstyret ditt kan gå av med pensjon. Som meg.

en: Gear like that deserves better posture. Shoulders back.
nn: Slikt utstyr fortener betre haldning. Skuldrene bak.

en: Grand. Another bag of stats to forget to repair.
nn: Flott. Endå ein pose eigenskapar du gløymer å reparere.

en: I'd have framed that. Then worn the frame.
nn: Eg ville ha sett det i ramme. Og så gått med ramma.

en: Mm. Respectable. My grandfather would have nodded.
nn: Mm. Respektabelt. Bestefar min ville ha nikka.

en: Ah, finally something worth tripping over in your bags.
nn: Å, endeleg noko verdt å snuble i i veskene dine.

en: You've got good taste. Or good luck. Probably luck.
nn: Du har god smak. Eller god lukke. Truleg lukke.

en: That's gear with a story. Make sure it's a good one.
nn: Det er utstyr med ei historie. Sjå til at ho blir god.

en: Fine plate, fine cloth, fine whatever. It's fine!
nn: Fin plate, fint tøy, fint kva som helst. Det er fint!

en: Now that's armour a veteran would wear. Eventually.
nn: Det er rustning ein veteran ville ha gått med. Etter kvart.

en: Took ages for me to see one of those. You got lucky.
nn: Det tok evigheiter før eg såg eit slikt. Du var heldig.

en: Look at it shimmer. My old buckler only ever dented.
nn: Sjå kor det skimrar. Det gamle skjoldet mitt berre bulka.

en: Hmph. That piece is wasted on the young. Wear it anyway.
nn: Hm. Det plagget er bortkasta på dei unge. Gå med det likevel.

en: You won't need my hand-me-downs anymore. Shame.
nn: Du treng ikkje arvegodset mitt lenger. Synd.

en: If that armour could talk, it'd ask for a better owner. Kidding.
nn: Om rustninga kunne snakke, ville ho bede om ein betre eigar. Tuller.

en: Fine drop. The old raid leader would've grunted approval.
nn: Fin drop. Den gamle raidleiaren ville ha grynta godkjennande.

en: Oh, very nice. I'll pretend I'm not impressed.
nn: Å, svært fint. Eg skal late som eg ikkje er imponert.

en: That'll turn heads. Mostly hostile ones.
nn: Det får hovud til å snu seg. Mest fiendtlege.

en: In my day, we'd pass that around so everyone could hold it.
nn: På mi tid ville vi ha sendt det rundt så alle fekk halde det.

en: Dress for the job you want. Apparently you want danger.
nn: Kle deg for jobben du vil ha. Du vil visst ha fare.

en: Well, it's no rusty helmet, but I suppose it'll do.
nn: Vel, det er ingen rusten hjelm, men det får vel duge.

en: Easy now. One shiny item doesn't make you a legend.
nn: Roleg no. Éin blank ting gjer deg ikkje til ei legende.

en: Good. Now go put it to work. Armour hates sitting idle.
nn: Bra. Set det i arbeid no. Rustning hatar å stå ubrukt.

en: Hm. It's heavy with glory. And probably with boss slime.
nn: Hm. Det er tungt av ære. Og truleg av sjefslim.

en: Look at the gleam! I've lost good eyesight for less.
nn: Sjå glansen! Eg har mista godt syn for mindre.

en: Bah. Show-off. Good drop, though.
nn: Pøh. Skrytepave. Men god drop.

en: There's an old saying: good armour, fewer funerals.
nn: Det finst eit gammalt ordtak: god rustning, færre gravferder.

en: That one'll outlive us all. Take care of it.
nn: Det plagget kjem til å overleve oss alle. Ta vare på det.

en: Another fine thing the young get handed. Sigh. Congrats.
nn: Endå ein fin ting dei unge får servert. Sukk. Gratulerer.

en: I'll write it down in the guild ledger. In big letters.
nn: Eg skriv det inn i laget sin protokoll. Med store bokstavar.

en: Not many get one like that. Not many deserve it, either.
nn: Ikkje mange får eit slikt. Ikkje mange fortener det heller.
